summary: A monophonic talking formant synth with a 303-style step sequencer: a saw wave through a three-formant vowel filter, where Tongue and Jaw controls morph between the vowels i, e, a, o and u.
features: Vowel plane with Tongue and Jaw, each with its own LFO
Voice, size and resonance controls, plus a resonant low-pass filter
303-style envelope and accent; drive and ping-pong delay
16-step sequencer with per-step vowel, accent and slide; 16 pattern slots
USB MIDI in, out and clock; USB audio; one voice only
